evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Rubrics enable reward assignment on tasks without verifiable answers, but are expensive to manually produce from scratch.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Alongside LLM self-critique and test-time scaling, Rubricon uses observed criterion pass rates on example model responses to guide refinement.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across five professional, consumer, clinical, and general-use LLM benchmarks, Rubricon produces rubrics whose scores of frontier LLM responses exhibit 9% greater alignment with labor-intensive expert-authored rubrics, compared to the best alternative synthetic rubric generation method among RRD, QSRG, OpenRubrics, and agentic generation via harnesses like Codex.
